title: Equality function as a sum of point indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The function that is $1$ exactly when all coordinates of $x$ are equal, and $0$ otherwise, equals the sum over $\mathbb F_2$ of the point indicators of the all-zero and all-one vectors, evaluated at $x$.
